This is well past the '>2 logical moves' threshold and is not a tight sequential-build the way Prompt 2's single-paragraph walkthrough is (Prompt 2's four asks all build one continuous incident-to-mitigation narrative; Prompt 1's are a checklist of distinct setup/execution/report duties that would not read as artificial if split). Harm: exactly the failure mode named in the rule text — a dense run-on where Claude (or the student) drops a structural signal, plausibly the 'don't pick yet' instruction buried mid-paragraph.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Split into paragraphs by move: (1) pre-flight + dispatch stride in a subagent, (2) save the list and flag high-severity items, (3) don't pick yet; report whether stride loaded and which file it used.
